<entry name="Tyranids/LictorDescription" value="A stealthy melee infantry unit, capable of a single Deep Strike teleport to strike anywhere on the battlefield.
This Unit is not affected by Tyranid Instinctive Behavior."/>
<entry name="Necrons/SmallGaussPylonFlavor" value=""/>
<entry name="Tau/BuilderDroneDescription" value="Drone unit that repairs Buildings, Battlesuits and Tanks, clears tiles and founds new cities.
Can be build in the Headquarter, Shas'm Barracks, Auxiliary Deployment Hub or Fio'Xar Arsenal "/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/RazorbackDescription" value="Tank unit that transports infantry. If adjacent to another Razorback, both ignore a part of enemy cover.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine and Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/WhirlwindDescription" value="Artillery tank with a variety of missiles to pound enemy positions from afar. If adjacent to another Whirlwind, both gain extra Range and Damage.
This unit benefits from Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/HunterDescription" value="Tank unit specialized in taking down enemy vehicles. While stationary, this unit gains +1 Range. If adjacent to another Hunter, both gain increased Accuracy.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/PredatorDescription" value="Main battle tank unit. If adjacent to another Predator, both gain extra Damage against Monsters, Vehicles and Fortifications.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/VindicatorDescription" value="Heavy tank unit with a devastating close-range cannon. If adjacent to another Vindicator, both ignore enemy cover.
This unit benefits from Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/ApothecaryDescription" value="Infantry unit that heals allied infantry. Can be build in the Reclusiam or Apothecarion.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/ThunderfireCannonDescription" value="Infantry unit that provides long-range barrage support and can clear tiles and repair vehicles. Can be build in the Reclusiam or Apothecarion.
This unit benefits from Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/AssaultSpaceMarineDescription" value="Melee infantry unit equipped with jump packs to overcome terrain obstacles.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/AssaultTerminatorDescription" value="Heavy melee infantry unit equipped with a powerful weapon and shield.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/DevastatorCenturionDescription" value="Very bulky infantry unit with massive armaments.
This unit benefits from Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/DevastatorSpaceMarineDescription" value="Infantry unit equipped to bring down heavy war machines.
This unit benefits from Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/DreadnoughtDescription" value="Heavy walker unit that crushes opponents in close combat.
This unit benefits from Assault and Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/LandRaiderDescription" value="Massively armoured and heavily armed transport unit.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine, Assault and Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/LandSpeederDescription" value="Mobile hover vehicle unit that can even traverse water.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine and Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/PrimarisAggressorDescription" value="Close-quarters anti-infantry unit equipped with flamestorm gauntlets.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine and Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/PrimarisHellblasterDescription" value="Heavy armour-piercing ranged infantry.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/PrimarisInceptorDescription" value="Powerful short-range unit equipped with jump packs.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/PrimarisIntercessorDescription" value="Tough versatile infantry unit.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/PrimarisInvaderATVDescription" value="Fast vehicle equipped with a gatling cannon.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/PrimarisRepulsorExecutionerDescription" value="Heavy tank with transport capabilities and a significant payload of ranged weapons.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/RedemptorDreadnoughtDescription" value="Powerful walker unit with a vast array of weapons.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/ScoutDescription" value="Infantry unit specializing in reconnaissance and infiltration.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/ScoutBikerDescription" value="Fast reconnaissance unit.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/StormravenGunshipDescription" value="Heavily armed and armoured airborne transport unit.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine, Devastator Doctrine and Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/StormSpeederThunderstrikeDescription" value="Fast assault vehicle with a powerful anti-armour armament.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine and Devastator Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/StormtalonGunshipDescription" value="Airborne interceptor and ground-attack unit.
This unit benefits from Assault Doctrine, Devastator Doctrine and Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/TacticalSpaceMarineDescription" value="Versatile infantry unit.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/TerminatorDescription" value="Heavily armoured infantry unit that can take on virtually every ground opponent.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
<entry name="SpaceMarines/TacticalSpaceMarine1Description" value="Versatile infantry unit.
This unit benefits from Tactical Doctrine bonuses."/>
